outcome: requiring an up-front two-unit packed red blood cell protocol
cohort: The study included 685 hemodynamically stable women with post-partum anemia who received transfusion of packed red blood cells between 2013 and 2023.
finding: In this cohort, despite some factors showing significance in univariate analysis, no independent predictors for requiring two units of packed red blood cells were identified in multivariate analysis.
mod_finding: In univariate analysis, the duration of cesarean delivery and episiotomy during vaginal delivery were significant risk factors for requiring two packed red blood cell units.
